description: This file is a PHP script responsible for displaying a list of workflows within the vtiger CRM application. It primarily sets up the environment, checks permissions, prepares data through various utility classes, and renders a Smarty template to show workflows.

classes.name: VTWorkflowApplication
classes.description: Application class for workflow operations within vtiger CRM.

classes.name: VTWorkflowUtils
classes.description: Utility class for workflow related functions and permission checks.

classes.name: Vtiger_Cron
classes.description: Class managing cron jobs in vtiger CRM.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class customized for vtiger CRM.

methods.name: vtDisplayWorkflowList
methods.description: Main function to display the list of workflows with permission checks and template rendering.
